name: depth-card-stack
title: Depth Card Stack
description: 3D stacked card carousel with perspective depth, gyroscopic tilt on hover, texture reveal effect, physics throw animation, and autoplay

changelog.summary: Removed the rotation prop and matched the headline color to the supporting line.
Removed content, activeIndex, and depth controls; added working rotation, duration, mouseInteraction, bgVisible, lerp, and smoothness props.

Added cards as a public prop with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested activeIndex/depth/rotation/duration props don't exist here - card positions come from a fixed hand-tuned per-slot table (getSlotProps), not a linear depth/rotation formula - so they were dropped rather than shipping non-functional controls.
Disable pointer tilt and texture reveal under reduced motion

props.name: mouseInteraction
props.description: Enables pointer tilt and texture reveal on the active card.

props.name: lerp
props.description: Pointer-follow smoothing amount; higher values track faster.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: Hover enter/leave smoothing duration for card tilt and texture reveal.
